title: The Koo Dataset: An Indian Microblogging Platform With Global Ambitions

bias_targets.methodology: Computing the Gini coefficient for the set of web domains shared by each linguistic community to measure news diversity, epistemic bubbles, and the dominance of individual news outlets.
Analyzing the editorial alignment of top-shared news domains and examining the prevalence of political hashtags to identify pro- and anti-government sentiments and ideological polarization.
